scope: Independent read-only review of the new Greenbelt functions and their ten tests. No collector edits or additional publisher requests.
findings: Manifest completeness checks count, hasMoreUpcoming, failure flag, native organizer identity and unique canonical event URLs.
Detail checks native event ID, canonical URL, title, organizer and organization; public live status, local/UTC agreement and real end time are required.

Complete overview and every native structured text module are retained. Unknown widgets/module shapes, blank bodies and oversize prose are held rather than clipped. A genuinely complete overview with an empty module list is accepted.
Full publisher venue street and city/ZIP must match one of two separately reviewed named NYC Parks facilities; High Rock Nevada parking lot is not confused with the park gate.
Partial checkpoints emit no events. Hydration resumes at persisted cursor; final ordinary organizer manifest must match before complete output is released.

Checkpoint validation binds queue, native event IDs, body validity, venue tuple, points, organizer, diagnostic coverage, UTC start and local date window; failed detail fetches cannot mutate the input checkpoint.
Expired rows become explicit held diagnostics on completion; no private, cancelled or missing meeting location record is manufactured.
limit: Review covers code, focused regressions and frozen ordinary-HTTP parser capture. Production publication and live transport behavior remain release-owner verification.
